originality.rationale: Nearest prior is Driver-Jordaan 2016 (SIGMA 12:042, arXiv:1510.08599) Thm 3.1: necessary and sufficient delta<x_{2,n} with delta=-1-2(beta+1)/(alpha+beta+2n+2) for P_n^{(alpha,beta)} vs P_n^{(alpha,beta+2)} interlacing in alpha>-1,-2<beta<-1. Full-text HTML inspected: only numerics are n=5 alpha=2.35 beta=-1.5 (holds, delta=-0.922179<x2=-0.885666) vs beta=-1.9 (fails); no fixed-(n=6,alpha=0) certified table, violation witness, or transition bracket. The conditional criterion does not mechanically imply per-beta verdicts because x_{2,6} has no closed form and must be rigorously enclosed; Sec 5 bounds only x_{1,n}. Classical sources (DLMF 18.16/18.2(vi), Szego Thm 3.3.2) require alpha,beta>-1 or [-1/2,1/2] windows, inapplicable in beta in (-2,-1); scipy roots_jacobi rejects beta<-1. Method differs (exact Sturm/IVT certificate from definitional sum vs conditional mixed-recurrence theory). Substantive gap confirmed, not by timestamp/failed search.
